name: Science misconceptions benchmark (Learning Equality)
summary: A planned benchmark, dataset of assessment packages and small on-device classifiers for spotting science misconceptions in students' free-form answers.

license.note: The project page says its public goods are "all openly licensed" and names CC BY 4.0 only for the assessment packages.

access_note: The benchmark is to be released on Hugging Face.
cite: Learning Equality. A Benchmark for AI Identification of Science Misconceptions in Free-Form Student Responses. K-12 AI Infrastructure Program project, https://k12-ai-infrastructure.org/learning-equality/
expected: The project page gives no date; the Program expects its new public goods to be released in summer 2027.

fits.how: Its misconceptions could be context the AI listens for, and its classifiers could mark misconceptions in learners' answers for the teacher.
